Aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip. That mix runs code editors, browsers and Docker smoothly at this budget.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum. Pick one where you can upgrade to 32 GB later.
Screen and keyboard: A 14 or 15.6 inch Full HD IPS screen and a comfortable keyboard matter more than extra power, since you'll stare at them all day.
Battery: Look for 8+ hours of real use, and a light body if you carry it daily.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you plan games or machine learning work. It adds weight and cost.

Is your work mostly web and apps, or AI and data?
